procedure: Create a synthetic Original or TR on UHID Bluetooth and verify exact-owned hid-wiimote binding. Keep the MotionPlus evdev node open before SDL starts and until it exits. Use a fresh SDL process per arm, the Wii HIDAPI hint, and the expected owned raw path. Drive two distinct synthetic gyroscope vectors throughout a 26-second post-open window. Read the cached SDL fields and record protocol and dispatch decisions in a local logging-only SDL build. Capture provider and exact-owned hidraw traffic independently.
semantic_outcome: SDL 3.4.20, Original with MotionPlus: 0 gyro events and 0 nonzero gyro events, 1 joystick removals, and 3491 of 5037 disconnected polls. Final cached presence 0, mode 0x00. Initialization read active mode 0x04 and issued the reset. Linux activation was bypassed. After the open reset and an interleaved readback, SDL advertised no gyro. SDL received four valid reports for the driven gyro vector and skipped all four at the cached-mode gate. The periodic check later saw active mode 0x04 without updating the cache and removed the joystick. The kernel holder saw changing gyro.
